annotations.title: Get tender bid or skip decision

description: Return the saved score, bid-or-skip recommendation and reasons for one tender matched to the signed-in TenderLead account. Returns tier, data_notice and opportunity containing the source notice, available dates and values, and assessment. Requires Pro or Team. A missing match returns an isError result with error and message.

contract_id.description: contract_id UUID returned by get_daily_brief or search_tenders for this account.

name: get_tender_decision

data_notice.description: Safety notice for untrusted external text.

opportunity.description: The matched notice and available saved assessment.

contract_id.description: TenderLead notice identifier; use for get_tender_decision or save_tender.

deadline.description: Notice deadline when available; check the original notice for changes.

estimated_value.description: Published estimated contract value when available, in currency.

recommendation.description: Saved BID or SKIP recommendation, not submission approval.

score.description: Available fit assessment from 0 to 100; null or absent means no usable score.

source_url.description: Link to the original public notice; verify submission requirements there.

tier.description: Effective account access tier for this read.

title: Get tender bid or skip decision
